items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Tightness not considered serious issue
items.description:
McCaffrey is dealing with "tightness," but it doesn't seem to be an issue to worry about, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: In line to miss roughly two months
items.description:
Tyson is expected to miss about two months due to the hamstring injury he suffered last week, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Groin strain is considered 'minor'
items.description:
The follow-up on the groin injury Hall sustained Monday confirmed that the injury is minor, according to Connor Hughes of SNY.tv.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Diagnosed with hyperextended knee
items.description:
Monangai hyperextended his right knee at Sunday's practice, and he's expected to be sidelined multiple weeks, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Full practice Monday
items.description:
Price (lower body) participated fully in Monday's practice, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
